newsitem.title: INDIA: India HLL interim div at 7.5 rupees/shr.
newsitem.headline: India HLL interim div at 7.5 rupees/shr.

text.p: The directors of Hindustan Lever Ltd (HLL) said on Tuesday it had set an interim dividend of 7.5 rupees per share of 10 rupee face value for calendar 1997.
Shareholders whose names appear in the books on October 10 will be eligible for the dividend, a company statement said after the board met in the southern city of Bangalore.
The dividend is payable on November 4.
Hindustan Lever is the Indian subsidiary of Anglo-Dutch conglomerate Unilever Plc.
The firm said its net profit in the first six months to June 30 totalled 2.56 billion rupees, which included that of its merged affiliate Brooke Bond Lipton India Ltd.
The net profit in the first half of 1996 was 1.85 billion rupees before the merger took effect.
